title: A finite morphism is separated, universally closed and has finite fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Then (1) $f$ is separated and universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism] (indeed proper); in particular $f$ is a closed map: $f(Z)$ is closed in $Y$ for every closed subset $Z\subseteq X$; (2) for every $y\in Y$ the fibre $f^{-1}(\{y\})\subseteq X$ is a finite set.
